items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued September 25 at 10:38AM EDT until September 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Coastal Pender and Coastal New Hanover Counties.

* WHEN...Today.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 25 at 9:03AM EDT until September 26 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
